customManagers.description: The MySQL server of the integration tests, pinned by version and digest in ci/services.sh: MYSQL_IMAGE=mysql:<tag>@sha256:<digest>.

packageRules.description: The workflows' MySQL service was mysql:8.0: stay on 8.0, and take its patches and digests.
ci/services.sh downloads the Temurin 17 JRE (the runner's Java) from the temurin17 releases: take its updates within 17.
